sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: The minor then consists of five courses (minimum 3 credits each) on French or Francophone topics, which in the Department of Romance Studies must be taken at the FREN 2095 French Intermediate Composition and Conversation II -level and higher. Students may apply up to two courses from abroad or from another institution toward a French minor. Two of these courses may be in English; the minimum grade is B-.
